title: Dynabeads for IP Reagent-In-Plate Preparation
author: Opentrons
materials: Antibody solutions (reagent stock in 15 mL tubes, slot 5) is

steps.title: Transfer bead slurry
steps.instruction: Using the OT2, pipette the bead slurry from the 15 mL conical tube (reagent stock) located in slot 5 onto the 96‑well deep‑well reagent plate.

steps.title: Transfer antibody solutions
steps.instruction: Using the OT2, pipette the antibody solution from the 15 mL conical tube (reagent stock) located in slot 5 onto the 96‑well deep‑well reagent plate.
